AccountingSubledgerGrowthEdition.name: AccountingSubledgerGrowthEdition
AccountingSubledgerGrowthEdition.description: Provides three permission sets that enable access to Accounting Subledger Growth features.

AccountingSubledgerStarterEdition.name: AccountingSubledgerStarterEdition
AccountingSubledgerStarterEdition.description: Provides three permission sets that enable access to Accounting Subledger Starter features.

AccountingSubledgerUser.name: AccountingSubledgerUser
AccountingSubledgerUser.description: Enables organization-wide access to Accounting Subledger Growth features when the package is installed.

AccountInspection.name: AccountInspection
AccountInspection.description: Enables the Account Intelligence view. The Account Intelligence view is a consolidated dashboard showing account metrics, activities, and related opportunities and cases.

AddCustomApps.name: AddCustomApps
AddCustomApps.description: Increases the maximum number of custom apps allowed in an org. Indicate a value from 1–30.

AddCustomObjects.name: AddCustomObjects
AddCustomObjects.description: Increases the maximum number of custom objects allowed in the org. Indicate a value from 1–30.

AddCustomRelationships.name: AddCustomRelationships
AddCustomRelationships.description: Increases the maximum number of custom relationships allowed on an object. Indicate a value from 1–10.

AddCustomTabs.name: AddCustomTabs
AddCustomTabs.description: Increases the maximum number of custom tabs allowed in an org. Indicate a value from 1–30.

AddDataComCRMRecordCredit.name: AddDataComCRMRecordCredit
AddDataComCRMRecordCredit.description: Increases record import credits assigned to a user in your scratch org. Indicate a value from 1–30.

AddInsightsQueryLimit.name: AddInsightsQueryLimit
AddInsightsQueryLimit.description: Increases the size of your CRM Analytics query results. Indicate a value from 1–30 (multiplier is 10). Setting the quantity to 6 increases the query results to 60.

AdditionalFieldHistory.name: AdditionalFieldHistory
AdditionalFieldHistory.description: Increases the number of fields you can track history for beyond the default, which is 20 fields. Indicate a value between 1–40.

AdmissionsConnectUser.name: AdmissionsConnectUser
AdmissionsConnectUser.description: Enables the Admissions Connect components. Without this scratch org feature parameter, the custom Admissions Connect components render as blank.

AdvisorLinkFeature.name: AdvisorLinkFeature
AdvisorLinkFeature.description: Enables the Student Success Hub components. Without this scratch org feature parameter, the custom Student Success Hub components render as blank.

AdvisorLinkPathwaysFeature.name: AdvisorLinkPathwaysFeature
AdvisorLinkPathwaysFeature.description: Enables the Pathways components. Without this scratch org feature parameter, the custom Pathways components render as blank.

AgentforceVibesIDEForDE.name: AgentforceVibesIDEForDE
AgentforceVibesIDEForDE.description: Enables Agentforce Vibes access specifically tailored for Developer Edition (DE) environments and IDE-based development workflows. This feature enables developers to build, test, and iterate on Agentforce-driven AI experiences directly within integrated development environment (IDE) tools in a designated scratch org.

AgentforceVibesUnmeteredAccess.name: AgentforceVibesUnmeteredAccess
AgentforceVibesUnmeteredAccess.description: Provides unmetered access to Agentforce Vibes with included AI models for standard prompting and development workflows. Enables teams to build, iterate, and experiment with AI-assisted experiences without per-interaction credit consumption.

AIAttribution.name: AIAttribution
AIAttribution.description: Provides access to Einstein Attribution for Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. Einstein Attribution uses AI modeling to dynamically assign attribution percentages to multiple campaign touchpoints.
AIAttribution.editionNotes: available in Account Engagement Advanced and Premium editions.

AllUserIdServiceAccess.name: AllUserIdServiceAccess
AllUserIdServiceAccess.description: Enables all users to access all users’ information via the user ID service.

AnalyticsAdminPerms.name: AnalyticsAdminPerms
AnalyticsAdminPerms.description: Enables all permissions required to administer the CRM Analytics platform, including permissions to enable creating CRM Analytics templated apps and CRM Analytics Apps.

AnalyticsAppEmbedded.name: AnalyticsAppEmbedded
AnalyticsAppEmbedded.description: Provides one CRM Analytics Embedded App license for the CRM Analytics platform.

ApexGuruCodeAnalyzer.name: ApexGuruCodeAnalyzer
ApexGuruCodeAnalyzer.description: Enables ApexGuru’s generative AI-powered runtime insights in Salesforce Code Analyzer, which delivers Apex code quality recommendations directly in developer IDEs.

ApexIntegrationTests.name: ApexIntegrationTests
ApexIntegrationTests.description: Enables you to run end-to-end Apex tests that make callouts to Agentforce and Data 360. Integration tests relax callout restrictions and transaction rollback semantics, so you can validate real service interactions and assert on actual side effects in your scratch org, without mock callouts.

API.name: API
API.description: Even in the editions (Professional, Group) that don’t provide API access, REST API is enabled by default. Use this scratch org feature to access additional APIs (SOAP, Streaming, Bulk, Bulk 2.0).

ArcGraphCommunity.name: ArcGraphCommunity
ArcGraphCommunity.description: Lets you add Actionable Relationship Center (ARC) components to Experience Cloud pages so your users can view ARC Relationship Graphs.

Assessments.name: Assessments
Assessments.description: Enables dynamic Assessments features, which enables both Assessment Questions and Assessment Question Sets.

AssetScheduling.name: AssetScheduling
AssetScheduling.description: Enables Asset Scheduling license. Asset Scheduling makes it easier to book rooms and equipments. Indicate a value between 1–10.

AssociationEngine.name: AssociationEngine
AssociationEngine.description: Enables the Association Engine, which automatically associates new accounts with the user’s current branch by creating branch unit customer records.

AuthorApex.name: AuthorApex
AuthorApex.description: Enables you to access and modify Apex code in a scratch org. Enabled by default in Enterprise and Developer Editions.

B2BCommerce.name: B2BCommerce
B2BCommerce.description: Provides the B2B License. B2BCommerce enables business-to-business (B2B) commerce in your org. Create and update B2B stores. Create and manage buyer accounts. Sell products to other businesses.
B2BCommerce.editionNotes: Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

B2BLoyaltyManagement.name: B2BLoyaltyManagement
B2BLoyaltyManagement.description: Enables the B2B Loyalty Management license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.

B2CCommerceGMV.name: B2CCommerceGMV
B2CCommerceGMV.description: Provides the B2B2C Commerce License. B2B2C Commerce allows you to quickly stand up an ecommerce site to promote brands and sell products into multiple digital channels. You can create and update retail storefronts in your org, and create and manage person accounts.
B2CCommerceGMV.editionNotes: Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

B2CLoyaltyManagement.name: B2CLoyaltyManagement
B2CLoyaltyManagement.description: Enables the Loyalty Management - Growth license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.

B2CLoyaltyManagementPlus.name: B2CLoyaltyManagementPlus
B2CLoyaltyManagementPlus.description: Enables the Loyalty Management - Advanced license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.

BatchManagement.name: BatchManagement
BatchManagement.description: Enables the Batch Management license. Batch Management allows you to process a high volume of records in manageable batches.

BenefitManagement.name: BenefitManagement
BenefitManagement.description: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing benefits programs, benefit disbursements, and benefit applicant tracking in Public Sector Solutions.

BigObjectsBulkAPI.name: BigObjectsBulkAPI
BigObjectsBulkAPI.description: Enables the scratch org to use BigObjects in the Bulk API.

BillingAdvanced.name: BillingAdvanced
BillingAdvanced.description: Enables access to all the Billing features and objects that are available with the Revenue Cloud Billing license in the scratch org.
BillingAdvanced.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

Briefcase.name: Briefcase
Briefcase.description: Enables the use of Briefcase Builder in a scratch org, which allows you to create offline briefcases that make selected records available for viewing offline.

BudgetManagement.name: BudgetManagement
BudgetManagement.description: Gives users access to budget management features and objects. To enable budget management, add this feature to your scratch org definition file.

BusinessRulesEngine.name: BusinessRulesEngine
BusinessRulesEngine.description: Enables Business Rules Engine, which enables both expression sets and lookup tables.

BYOCCaaS.name: BYOCCaaS
BYOCCaaS.description: Enables you to set up and test a partner contact center that integrates with supported Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) providers in your scratch org.
BYOCCaaS.editionNotes: Available in Salesforce Enterprise and Developer Editions.

BYOOTT.name: BYOOTT
BYOOTT.description: Enables you to set up and test a Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging channel that integrates with supported Messaging providers in your scratch org.
BYOOTT.editionNotes: Available in Salesforce Enterprise and Developer Editions.

CacheOnlyKeys.name: CacheOnlyKeys
CacheOnlyKeys.description: Enables the cache-only keys service. This feature allows you to store your key material outside of Salesforce, and have the Cache-Only Key Service fetch your key on demand from a key service that you control.

CalloutSizeMB.name: CalloutSizeMB
CalloutSizeMB.description: Increases the maximum size of an Apex callout. Indicate a value between 3–12.

CampaignInfluence2.name: CampaignInfluence2
CampaignInfluence2.description: Provides access to Customizable Campaign Influence for Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. Customizable Campaign Influence can auto-associate or allow manual creation of relationships among campaigns and opportunities to track attribution.
CampaignInfluence2.editionNotes: available in Salesforce Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and Developer Editions.

CascadeDelete.name: CascadeDelete
CascadeDelete.description: Provides lookup relationships with the same cascading delete functionality previously only available to master-detail relationships. To prevent records from being accidentally deleted, cascade-delete is disabled by default.

CaseClassification.name: CaseClassification
CaseClassification.description: Enables Einstein Case Classification. Case Classification offers recommendations to your agents so they can select the best value. You can also automatically save the best recommendation and route the case to the right agent.

CaseWrapUp.name: CaseWrapUp
CaseWrapUp.description: Enables Einstein Case Wrap-Up. To help agents complete cases quickly, Einstein Case Wrap-Up recommends case field values based on past chat transcripts.
CaseWrapUp.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.

CGAnalytics.name: CGAnalytics
CGAnalytics.description: Enables the Consumer Goods Analytics org perm in scratch orgs.

ChangeDataCapture.name: ChangeDataCapture
ChangeDataCapture.description: Enables Change Data Capture, if the scratch org edition doesn’t automatically enable it.

Chatbot.name: Chatbot
Chatbot.description: Enables deployment of Bot metadata into a scratch org, and allows you to create and edit bots.

ChatterEmailFooterLogo.name: ChatterEmailFooterLogo
ChatterEmailFooterLogo.description: ChatterEmailFooterLogo allows you to use the Document ID of a logo image, which you can use to customize chatter emails.

ChatterEmailFooterText.name: ChatterEmailFooterText
ChatterEmailFooterText.description: ChatterEmailFooterText allows you to use footer text in customized Chatter emails.

ChatterEmailSenderName.name: ChatterEmailSenderName
ChatterEmailSenderName.description: ChatterEmailSenderName allows you to customize the name that appears as the sender’s name in the email notification. For example, your company’s name.

CleanEnergyProgramManagement.name: CleanEnergyProgramManagement
CleanEnergyProgramManagement.description: Enables Clean Energy Program Management capabilities in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for setting up, targeting, deploying, and managing clean energy, energy efficiency, and low-income programs. It includes Omnistudio, Business Rules Engine (BRE), Product Catalog Management, Action Plans, Program Management, Outcome Management, and platform access for the Program Management Console and Contractor Portal.
CleanEnergyProgramManagement.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

CloneApplication.name: CloneApplication
CloneApplication.description: CloneApplication allows you to clone an existing custom Lightning app and make required customizations to the new app. This way, you don’t have to start from scratch, especially when you want to create apps with simple variations.

CMSMaxContType.name: CMSMaxContType
CMSMaxContType.description: Limits the number of distinct content types you can create within Salesforce CMS to 21.

CMSMaxNodesPerContType.name: CMSMaxNodesPerContType
CMSMaxNodesPerContType.description: Limits the maximum number of child nodes (fields) you can create for a particular content type to 15.

CMSUnlimitedUse.name: CMSUnlimitedUse
CMSUnlimitedUse.description: Enables unlimited content records, content types, and bandwidth usage in Salesforce CMS.

Communities.name: Communities
Communities.description: Allows the org to create an Experience Cloud site. Experience Cloud uses the term Communities in its configuration. To use Communities, you must also include communitiesSettings > enableNetworksEnabled in the settings section of your scratch org definition file.
Communities.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

CompareReportsOrgPerm.name: CompareReportsOrgPerm
CompareReportsOrgPerm.description: Enables the org permission to allow for comparison of Lightning Reports.

ConAppPluginExecuteAsUser.name: ConAppPluginExecuteAsUser
ConAppPluginExecuteAsUser.description: Enables the pluginExecutionUser field in the ConnectedApp Metadata API object.

ConcStreamingClients.name: ConcStreamingClients
ConcStreamingClients.description: Increases the maximum number of concurrent clients (subscribers) across all channels and for all event types for API version 36.0 and earlier. Indicate a value between 20–4,000.

ConnectedAppCustomNotifSubscription.name: ConnectedAppCustomNotifSubscription
ConnectedAppCustomNotifSubscription.description: Enables connected apps to subscribe to custom notification types, which are used to send custom desktop and mobile notifications.

ConnectedAppToolingAPI.name: ConnectedAppToolingAPI
ConnectedAppToolingAPI.description: Enables the use of connected apps with the Tooling API.

ConsentEventStream.name: ConsentEventStream
ConsentEventStream.description: Enables the Consent Event Stream permission for the org.

ConsolePersistenceInterval.name: ConsolePersistenceInterval
ConsolePersistenceInterval.description: Increases how often console data is saved, in minutes. Indicate a value between 0–500. To disable auto save, set the value to 0.

ContactsToMultipleAccounts.name: ContactsToMultipleAccounts
ContactsToMultipleAccounts.description: Enables the contacts to multiple accounts feature. This feature lets you relate a contact to two or more accounts.

ContractApprovals.name: ContractApprovals
ContractApprovals.description: Enables contract approvals, which allow you to track contracts through an approval process.

ContractManagement.name: ContractManagement
ContractManagement.description: Enables the Contract Lifecycle (CLM) Management features in the org.

ContractMgmtInd.name: ContractMgmtInd
ContractMgmtInd.description: Enables the Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) features for Industries.

CoreCpq.name: CoreCpq
CoreCpq.description: Enables read-write access to Revenue Cloud features and objects. To use Revenue Cloud, you must also include revenueManagementSettings > enableCoreCPQ in the settings section of your scratch org definition file.
CoreCpq.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

CPQ.name: CPQ
CPQ.description: Enables the licensed features required to install the Salesforce CPQ managed package but doesn’t install the package automatically.

CustomerDataPlatform.name: CustomerDataPlatform
CustomerDataPlatform.description: Enables the CustomerDataPlatform license in scratch orgs.

CustomerDataPlatformLite.name: CustomerDataPlatformLite
CustomerDataPlatformLite.description: Enables the Data Cloud license in scratch orgs. You must also include the CustomerDataPlatform feature and enableCustomerDataPlatform Metadata API setting in your scratch org definition.

CustomerExperienceAnalytics.name: CustomerExperienceAnalytics
CustomerExperienceAnalytics.description: Enables the Customer Lifecycle Analytics org perm in scratch orgs.

CustomFieldDataTranslation.name: CustomFieldDataTranslation
CustomFieldDataTranslation.description: Enables translation of custom field data for Work Type Group, Service Territory, and Service Resource objects. You can enable data translation for custom fields with Text, Text Area, Text Area (Long), Text Area (Rich), and URL types.
CustomFieldDataTranslation.editionNotes: Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

CustomNotificationType.name: CustomNotificationType
CustomNotificationType.description: Allows the org to create custom notification types, which are used to send custom desktop and mobile notifications.

DataComDnbAccounts.name: DataComDnbAccounts
DataComDnbAccounts.description: Provides a license to Data.com account features.

DataComFullClean.name: DataComFullClean
DataComFullClean.description: Provides a license to Data.com cleaning features, and allows users to turn on auto fill clean settings for jobs.

DataMaskUser.name: DataMaskUser
DataMaskUser.description: Provides 30 Data Mask permission set licenses. This permission set enables access to an installed Salesforce Data Mask package.

DataProcessingEngine.name: DataProcessingEngine
DataProcessingEngine.description: Enables the Data Processing Engine license. Data Processing Engine helps transform data that’s available in your Salesforce org and write back the transformation results as new or updated records.

DebugApex.name: DebugApex
DebugApex.description: Enables Apex Interactive Debugger. You can use it to debug Apex code by setting breakpoints and checkpoints, and inspecting your code to find bugs.

DecisionTable.name: DecisionTable
DecisionTable.description: Enables Decision Table license. Decision tables read business rules and decide the outcome for records in your Salesforce org or for the values that you specify.

DefaultWorkflowUser.name: DefaultWorkflowUser
DefaultWorkflowUser.description: Sets the scratch org admin as the default workflow user.

DeferSharingCalc.name: DeferSharingCalc
DeferSharingCalc.description: Allows admins to suspend group membership and sharing rule calculations and to resume them later.

DevelopmentWave.name: DevelopmentWave
DevelopmentWave.description: Enables CRM Analytics development in a scratch org. It assigns five platform licenses and five CRM Analytics platform licenses to the org, along with assigning the permission set license to the admin user. It also enables the CRM Analytics Templates and Einstein Discovery features.

DevOpsCenter.name: DevOpsCenter
DevOpsCenter.description: Enables DevOps Center in scratch orgs so that partners can create second-generation managed packages that extend or enhance the functionality in the DevOps Center application (base) package.

DisableManageIdConfAPI.name: DisableManageIdConfAPI
DisableManageIdConfAPI.description: Limits access to the LoginIP and ClientBrowser API objects to allow view or delete only.

DisclosureFramework.name: DisclosureFramework
DisclosureFramework.description: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to configure Disclosure and Compliance Hub.

Division.name: Division
Division.description: Turns on the Manage Divisions feature under Company Settings. Divisions let you segment your organization’s data into logical sections, making searches, reports, and list views more meaningful to users. Divisions are useful for organizations with extremely large amounts of data.

DocGen.name: DocGen
DocGen.description: Enables the Document Generation Feature in the Org.

DocGenDesigner.name: DocGenDesigner
DocGenDesigner.description: Enables the designers to create and configure document templates.

DocGenInd.name: DocGenInd
DocGenInd.description: Enables the Industry Document Generation features in the org.

DocumentChecklist.name: DocumentChecklist
DocumentChecklist.description: Enables Document Tracking and Approval features, and adds the Document Checklist permission set. Document tracking features let you define documents to upload and approve, which supports processes like loan applications or action plans.

DocumentReaderPageLimit.name: DocumentReaderPageLimit
DocumentReaderPageLimit.description: Limits the number of pages sent for data extraction to 5.

DSARPortability.name: DSARPortability
DSARPortability.description: Enables an org to access the DSARPortability feature in Privacy Center. Also, provides one seat each of the PrivacyCenter and PrivacyCenterAddOn licenses.

DurableClassicStreamingAPI.name: DurableClassicStreamingAPI
DurableClassicStreamingAPI.description: Enables Durable PushTopic Streaming API for API version 37.0 and later.
DurableClassicStreamingAPI.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

DurableGenericStreamingAPI.name: DurableGenericStreamingAPI
DurableGenericStreamingAPI.description: Enables Durable Generic Streaming API for API version 37.0 and later.
DurableGenericStreamingAPI.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

DynamicClientCreationLimit.name: DynamicClientCreationLimit
DynamicClientCreationLimit.description: Allows the org to register up to 100 OAuth 2.0 connected apps through the dynamic client registration endpoint.

EAndUAgentforce.name: EAndUAgentforce
EAndUAgentforce.description: Enables access to Energy & Utilities Agentforce features in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for AI-powered agent capabilities specific to the energy and utilities industry, including Einstein GPT Platform, Prompt Builder, Copilot, Field Generation, Formulas, Einstein for Service Innovations, Generative Services, Agentforce Service Agent, Agentforce Employee Agent, and Agentforce Field Service Timesheet capabilities.
EAndUAgentforce.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUCoreSales.name: EAndUCoreSales
EAndUCoreSales.description: Enables Energy & Utilities Core Sales features in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for core sales capabilities, including Revenue Lifecycle Management, CSV import, and Commerce configurations (B2B and B2C). Use this feature to develop and test sales workflows for energy and utilities companies on the Salesforce platform.
EAndUCoreSales.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUCoreSelfServicePortal.name: EAndUCoreSelfServicePortal
EAndUCoreSelfServicePortal.description: Enables the Energy & Utilities Core Self Service Portal capabilities in your scratch org. This is a comprehensive feature that provisions licenses required for the Salesforce platform-based self-service portal, including Omnistudio, Business Rules Engine (BRE), Product Catalog Management, Action Plans, Program Management, Service Excellence, Experience Cloud (Customer Community), and platform experience capabilities. It also includes platform licenses for Self Service Portal access, Agent Console access, and Programs features.
EAndUCoreSelfServicePortal.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUCoreService.name: EAndUCoreService
EAndUCoreService.description: Enables Energy & Utilities Core Service capabilities in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for the EU Cloud core data model, service excellence, Omnistudio, Product Catalog Management, Knowledge, and the Agent Console platform access. Use this feature when you need the full core Energy & Utilities data model and service reps capabilities.
EAndUCoreService.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUCoreTimeSheetService.name: EAndUCoreTimeSheetService
EAndUCoreTimeSheetService.description: Enables Energy & Utilities Core Time Sheet Service capabilities in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for field service time sheet management, including Business Rules Engine (BRE), Field Service (with mobile, scheduling, and labor cost optimization), and Context Service capabilities. Use this feature to develop and test time sheet workflows for energy and utilities field service reps.
EAndUCoreTimeSheetService.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUDataKits.name: EAndUDataKits
EAndUDataKits.description: Enables Energy & Utilities Data features in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for using Commodity Data Kits, including Data 360 (CDP) capabilities, Data Spaces, segments and activations, and additional data storage. Use this feature to connect, harmonize, and analyze customer energy use data for sales and service at scale.
EAndUDataKits.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUDigitalSales.name: EAndUDigitalSales
EAndUDigitalSales.description: Enables the Energy & Utilities Digital Sales org permission in your scratch org. This feature provisions the sales add-on license required for Energy & Utilities digital sales capabilities, including guided selling flows and sales-specific configurations for energy and utilities companies.
EAndUDigitalSales.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EAndUSelfServicePortal.name: EAndUSelfServicePortal
EAndUSelfServicePortal.description: Enables the Energy & Utilities Self Service Portal org permission in your scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for building customer-facing self-service portals, including Omnistudio, Business Rules Engine (BRE), Product Catalog Management, Action Plans, Program Management, and Experience Cloud (Customer Community) capabilities. Use this feature to develop and test self-service digital experiences for energy and utilities customers.
EAndUSelfServicePortal.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EdPredictionM3Threshold.name: EdPredictionM3Threshold
EdPredictionM3Threshold.description: Sets the number of records in the payload to 10, after which the Einstein Discovery prediction service uses M3.

EdPredictionTimeout.name: EdPredictionTimeout
EdPredictionTimeout.description: Sets the maximum duration of a single Einstein Discovery prediction to 100 milliseconds.

EdPredictionTimeoutBulk.name: EdPredictionTimeoutBulk
EdPredictionTimeoutBulk.description: Sets the maximum duration of a single Einstein Discovery prediction when it runs in bulk to 10 milliseconds.

EdPredictionTimeoutByomBulk.name: EdPredictionTimeoutByomBulk
EdPredictionTimeoutByomBulk.description: Sets the maximum duration of a single Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) Einstein Discovery prediction to 100 milliseconds.

Einstein1AIPlatform.name: Einstein1AIPlatform
Einstein1AIPlatform.description: Provides access to Einstein generative AI features such as Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and the Models API. To use generative AI features, you must also include einsteinGptSettings > enableEinsteinGptPlatform in the settings section of your scratch org definition file.
Einstein1AIPlatform.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.

EinsteinAnalyticsPlus.name: EinsteinAnalyticsPlus
EinsteinAnalyticsPlus.description: Provides one CRM Analytics Plus license for the CRM Analytics platform.

EinsteinArticleRecommendations.name: EinsteinArticleRecommendations
EinsteinArticleRecommendations.description: Provides licenses for Einstein Article Recommendations. Einstein Article Recommendations uses data from past cases to identify Knowledge articles that are most likely to help your customer service agents address customer inquiries.
EinsteinArticleRecommendations.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.

EinsteinDocReader.name: EinsteinDocReader
EinsteinDocReader.description: Provides the license required to enable and use Intelligent Form Reader in a scratch org. Intelligent Form Reader uses optical character recognition to automatically extract data with Amazon Textract.

EinsteinRecommendationBuilder.name: EinsteinRecommendationBuilder
EinsteinRecommendationBuilder.description: Provides a license to create recommendations with Einstein Recommendation Builder. Einstein Recommendation Builder lets you build custom AI recommendations.

EinsteinSalesRepFdbk.name: EinsteinSalesRepFdbk
EinsteinSalesRepFdbk.description: Enables the Agentforce Sales Coach feature in an org. This scratch org feature also includes a large number of Einstein for Sales Generative AI features.

EinsteinSearch.name: EinsteinSearch
EinsteinSearch.description: Provides the license required to use and enable Einstein Search features in a scratch org.
EinsteinSearch.editionNotes: Available in Professional and Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.

EinsteinVisits.name: EinsteinVisits
EinsteinVisits.description: Enables Consumer Goods Cloud. With Consumer Goods cloud, transform the way you collaborate with your retail channel partners. Empower your sales managers to plan visits and analyze your business’s health across stores. Also, allow your field reps to track inventory, take orders, and capture visit details using the Retail Execution mobile app.

EinsteinVisitsED.name: EinsteinVisitsED
EinsteinVisitsED.description: Enables Einstein Discovery, which can be used to get store visit recommendations. With Einstein Visits ED, you can create a visit frequency strategy that allows Einstein to provide optimal store visit recommendations.

EmbeddedLoginForIE.name: EmbeddedLoginForIE
EmbeddedLoginForIE.description: Provides JavaScript files that support Embedded Login in IE11.

EmergencyManagement.name: EmergencyManagement
EmergencyManagement.description: Enables Emergency Management objects in your Energy & Utilities scratch org. This feature provisions the licenses required for emergency and incident management capabilities, including Field Service (with scheduling, dispatcher, and mobile), and incident management. Use this feature to develop and test emergency response workflows for energy and utilities companies.
EmergencyManagement.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

EmpPublishRateLimit.name: EmpPublishRateLimit
EmpPublishRateLimit.description: Increases the maximum number of standard-volume platform event notifications published per hour. Indicate a value between 1,000–10,000.

EnableManageIdConfUI.name: EnableManageIdConfUI
EnableManageIdConfUI.description: Enables access to the LoginIP and ClientBrowser API objects to verify a user’s identity in the UI.

Enablement.name: Enablement
Enablement.description: Enables features for creating, taking, and tracking sales programs with Enablement. Business operations experts and sales leaders identify the revenue outcomes they want sales reps to achieve, such as increased average deal sizes or shorter ramp times. Then, they create programs that help sales reps work towards those outcomes as part of their daily work.

EnablePRM.name: EnablePRM
EnablePRM.description: Enables the partner relationship management permissions for the org.

EnableSetPasswordInApi.name: EnableSetPasswordInApi
EnableSetPasswordInApi.description: Enables you to use `sf org generate password` to change a password without providing the old password.

EncryptionStatisticsInterval.name: EncryptionStatisticsInterval
EncryptionStatisticsInterval.description: Defines the interval (in seconds) between encryption statistics gathering processes. The maximum value is 604,800 seconds (7 days). The default is once per 86,400 seconds (24 hours).

EncryptionSyncInterval.name: EncryptionSyncInterval
EncryptionSyncInterval.description: Defines how frequently (in seconds) the org can synchronize data with the active key material. The default and maximum value is 604,800 seconds (7 days). To synchronize data more frequently, indicate a value, in seconds, equal to or larger than 0.

EnergyAndUtilitiesCloud.name: EnergyAndUtilitiesCloud
EnergyAndUtilitiesCloud.description: Enables the Energy & Utilities org permission in your scratch org. This feature provides the base Energy & Utilities capabilities, including the core service add-on license. Use this feature to develop and test Energy & Utilities solutions.
EnergyAndUtilitiesCloud.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

Entitlements.name: Entitlements
Entitlements.description: Enables entitlements. Entitlements are units of customer support in Salesforce, such as phone support or web support that represent terms in service agreements.

EntityTranslation.name: EntityTranslation
EntityTranslation.description: Enables translation of field data for Work Type Group, Service Territory, and Service Resource objects.
EntityTranslation.editionNotes: Not available in Professional, Partner Professional, Group, or Partner Group Edition orgs.

ERMAnalytics.name: ERMAnalytics
ERMAnalytics.description: Enables the ERM Analytics org perm in your scratch org.

EventLogFile.name: EventLogFile
EventLogFile.description: Enables API access to your org’s event log files. The event log files contain information about your org’s operational events that you can use to analyze usage trends and user behavior.

ExcludeSAMLSessionIndex.name: ExcludeSAMLSessionIndex
ExcludeSAMLSessionIndex.description: Excludes Session Index in SAML sign-on (SSO) and single logout (SLO) flows.

Explainability.name: Explainability
Explainability.description: Enables an org to use Decision Explainer features.

ExpressionSetMaxExecPerHour.name: ExpressionSetMaxExecPerHour
ExpressionSetMaxExecPerHour.description: Enables an org to run a maximum of 500,000 expression sets per hour by using Connect REST API.

ExternalIdentityLogin.name: ExternalIdentityLogin
ExternalIdentityLogin.description: Allows the scratch org to use Salesforce Customer Identity features associated with your External Identity license.

FieldAuditTrail.name: FieldAuditTrail
FieldAuditTrail.description: Enables Field Audit Trail for the org and allows a total 60 tracked fields. By default, 20 fields are tracked for all orgs, and 40 more are tracked with Field Audit Trail.

FieldService.name: FieldService
FieldService.description: Provides the Field Service license. Indicate a value between 1–25.

FieldServiceAppointmentAssistantUser.name: FieldServiceAppointmentAssistantUser
FieldServiceAppointmentAssistantUser.description: Adds the Field Service Appointment Assistant permission set license. Indicate a value between 1–25.

FieldServiceDispatcherUser.name: FieldServiceDispatcherUser
FieldServiceDispatcherUser.description: Adds the Field Service Dispatcher permission set license. Indicate a value between 1–25.

FieldServiceLastMileUser.name: FieldServiceLastMileUser
FieldServiceLastMileUser.description: Adds the Field Service Last Mile permission set license. Indicate a value between 1–25.

FieldServiceMobileExtension.name: FieldServiceMobileExtension
FieldServiceMobileExtension.description: Adds the Field Service Mobile Extension permission set license.

FieldServiceMobileUser.name: FieldServiceMobileUser
FieldServiceMobileUser.description: Adds the Field Service Mobile permission set license. Indicate a value between 1–25.

FieldServiceSchedulingUser.name: FieldServiceSchedulingUser
FieldServiceSchedulingUser.description: Adds the Field Service Scheduling permission set license. Indicate a value between 1–25.

FinanceLogging.name: FinanceLogging
FinanceLogging.description: Adds Finance Logging objects to a scratch org. This feature is required for Finance Logging.

FinancialServicesCommunityUser.name: FinancialServicesCommunityUser
FinancialServicesCommunityUser.description: Adds the Financial Services Insurance Community permission set license, and enables access to Financial Services insurance community components and objects. Indicate a value between 1–10.

FinancialServicesInsuranceUser.name: FinancialServicesInsuranceUser
FinancialServicesInsuranceUser.description: Adds the Financial Services Insurance permission set license, and enables access to Financial Services insurance components and objects.

FinancialServicesUser.name: FinancialServicesUser
FinancialServicesUser.description: Adds the Financial Services Cloud Standard permission set license. This permission set enables access to Lightning components and the standard version of Financial Services Cloud. Also provides access to the standard Salesforce objects and custom Financial Services Cloud objects. Indicate a value between 1–10.

FlowSites.name: FlowSites
FlowSites.description: Enables the use of flows in Salesforce Sites and customer portals.

ForceComPlatform.name: ForceComPlatform
ForceComPlatform.description: Adds one Salesforce Platform user license.

ForecastEnableCustomField.name: ForecastEnableCustomField
ForecastEnableCustomField.description: Enables custom currency and customer number fields for use as measures in forecasts based on opportunities.
ForecastEnableCustomField.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise Edition and Unlimited Edition scratch orgs, and requires enabling Salesforce Forecasting in Setup.

FSCAlertFramework.name: FSCAlertFramework
FSCAlertFramework.description: Makes Financial Services Cloud Record Alert entities accessible in the scratch org.

FSCServiceProcess.name: FSCServiceProcess
FSCServiceProcess.description: Enables the Service Process Studio feature of Financial Service Cloud. Provides 10 seats each of the IndustriesServiceExcellenceAddOn and FinancialServicesCloudStardardAddOn licenses. To enable the feature, you must also turn on the StandardServiceProcess setting in Setup and grant users the AccessToServiceProcess permission.

Fundraising.name: Fundraising
Fundraising.description: Gives users access to Nonprofit Cloud for Fundraising features and objects in Salesforce.

GenericStreaming.name: GenericStreaming
GenericStreaming.description: Enables Generic Streaming API for API version 36.0 and earlier.
GenericStreaming.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

GenStreamingEventsPerDay.name: GenStreamingEventsPerDay
GenStreamingEventsPerDay.description: Increases the maximum number of delivered event notifications within a 24-hour period, shared by all CometD clients, with generic streaming for API version 36.0 and earlier. Indicate a value between 10,000–50,000.

Grantmaking.name: Grantmaking
Grantmaking.description: Gives users access to Grantmaking features and objects in Salesforce and Experience Cloud.

GuidanceHubAllowed.name: GuidanceHubAllowed
GuidanceHubAllowed.description: Enables the Guidance Center panel in Lightning Experience. The Guidance Center shows suggested and assigned content in the user’s flow of work. Suggested content is related to the app or page where the user is working. Assigned content includes guidance sets for Salesforce admins, links or Trailhead modules assigned to users with Learning Paths, and Enablement programs for sales reps.
GuidanceHubAllowed.editionNotes: Not available in Group Edition scratch orgs.

HealthCloudEOLOverride.name: HealthCloudEOLOverride
HealthCloudEOLOverride.description: Salesforce retired the Health Cloud CandidatePatient object in Spring ‘22 to focus on the more robust Lead object. This scratch org feature allows you to override that retirement and access the object.

HealthCloudForCmty.name: HealthCloudForCmty
HealthCloudForCmty.description: Enables use of Health Cloud for Experience Cloud Sites.

HealthCloudMedicationReconciliation.name: HealthCloudMedicationReconciliation
HealthCloudMedicationReconciliation.description: Allows Medication Management to support Medication Reconciliation.

HealthCloudPNMAddOn.name: HealthCloudPNMAddOn
HealthCloudPNMAddOn.description: Enables use of Provider Network Management.

HealthCloudUser.name: HealthCloudUser
HealthCloudUser.description: This enables the scratch org to use the Health Cloud objects and features equivalent to the Health Cloud permission set license for one user.

HighVelocitySales.name: HighVelocitySales
HighVelocitySales.description: Provides Sales Engagement licenses and enables Salesforce Inbox. Sales Engagement optimizes the inside sales process with a high-productivity workspace. Sales managers can create custom sales processes that guide reps through handling different types of prospects. And sales reps can rapidly handle prospects with a prioritized list and other productivity-boosting features. The Sales Engagement feature can be deployed in scratch orgs, but the settings for the feature can’t be updated through the s

HighVolumePlatformEventAddOn.name: HighVolumePlatformEventAddOn
HighVolumePlatformEventAddOn.description: Increases the daily delivery allocation of high-volume platform events or change data capture events by 100,000 events. This scratch org feature simulates the purchase of an add-on. If the org has the `HighVolumePlatformEventAddOn`, the daily allocation is flexible and isn’t enforced strictly to allow for usage peaks.

HLSAnalytics.name: HLSAnalytics
HLSAnalytics.description: Enables the HLS Analytics org perm in scratch orgs.

HoursBetweenCoverageJob.name: HoursBetweenCoverageJob
HoursBetweenCoverageJob.description: The frequency in hours when the sharing inheritance coverage report can be run for an object. Indicate a value between 1–24.

IdentityProvisioningFeatures.name: IdentityProvisioningFeatures
IdentityProvisioningFeatures.description: Enables use of Salesforce Identity User Provisioning.

IgnoreQueryParamWhitelist.name: IgnoreQueryParamWhitelist
IgnoreQueryParamWhitelist.description: Ignores allowlisting rules for query parameter filter rules. If enabled, you can add any query parameter to the URL.

IndustriesActionPlan.name: IndustriesActionPlan
IndustriesActionPlan.description: Provides a license for Action Plans. Action Plans allow you to define the tasks or document checklist items for completing a business process.

IndustriesBranchManagement.name: IndustriesBranchManagement
IndustriesBranchManagement.description: Branch Management lets branch managers and administrators track the work output of branches, employees, and customer segments in Financial Services Cloud.

IndustriesCompliantDataSharing.name: IndustriesCompliantDataSharing
IndustriesCompliantDataSharing.description: Grants users access to participant management and advanced configuration for data sharing to improve compliance with regulations and company policies.

IndustriesManufacturingCmty.name: IndustriesManufacturingCmty
IndustriesManufacturingCmty.description: Provides the Manufacturing Sales Agreement for the Community permission set license, which is intended for the usage of partner community users. It also provides access to the Manufacturing community template for admins users to create communities.

IndustriesMfgAccountForecast.name: IndustriesMfgAccountForecast
IndustriesMfgAccountForecast.description: Enables Account Forecast. With Account Forecast, you can generate forecasts for your accounts based on orders, opportunities, and sales agreements. You can also create formulas to calculate your forecasts per the requirements of your company.

IndustriesMfgAdvncdAccFrcs.name: IndustriesMfgAdvncdAccFrcs
IndustriesMfgAdvncdAccFrcs.description: Enables Advanced Account Forecasting. With Advanced Account Forecasting, generate comprehensive, multi-horizon forecasts for sales, operations, inventory, service, and other aspects of your business. Tailor your forecasting configurations to your objectives to generate accurate, relevant forecasts.

IndustriesMfgPartnerVisitMgmt.name: IndustriesMfgPartnerVisitMgmt
IndustriesMfgPartnerVisitMgmt.description: Enables Partner Visit Management. Partner Visit Management helps sales managers in your company schedule visits to partner and distributor locations. Sales managers can use those visits to monitor performance, arrange for periodic check-ins, conduct trainings, upsell and cross-sell products, and follow up on sales agreement renewals and warranty expiration.

IndustriesMfgProgram.name: IndustriesMfgProgram
IndustriesMfgProgram.description: Enables Program Based Business. With Program Based Business, program managers can manage the end-to-end lifecycle of a program where they derive forecasts based on their customers’ forecasts, transform these forecasts into business opportunities, and convert those opportunities into run-rate business. Program based business is common across multiple industries such as process, aerospace, defense, automotive, engineer-to-order, and make-to-order environments.

IndustriesMfgRebates.name: IndustriesMfgRebates
IndustriesMfgRebates.description: Enables Rebate Management. Manage incentive programs, track rebate attainment, automate payouts, and gain insights into sales performance and program effectiveness.

IndustriesMfgTargets.name: IndustriesMfgTargets
IndustriesMfgTargets.description: Enables Sales Agreements. With Sales Agreements, you can negotiate purchase and sale of products over a continued period. You can also get insights into products, prices, discounts, and quantities. And you can track your planned and actual quantities and revenues with real-time updates from orders and contracts.

InsightsPlatform.name: InsightsPlatform
InsightsPlatform.description: Enables the CRM Analytics Plus license for CRM Analytics.

InsuranceCalculationUser.name: InsuranceCalculationUser
InsuranceCalculationUser.description: Enables the calculation feature of Insurance. Provides 10 seats each of the BRERuntimeAddOn and OmniStudioRuntime licenses. Also, provides one seat each of the OmniStudio and BREPlatformAccess licenses.

InsuranceClaimMgmt.name: InsuranceClaimMgmt
InsuranceClaimMgmt.description: Enables claim management features. Provides one seat of the InsuranceClaimMgmtAddOn license.

InsurancePolicyAdmin.name: InsurancePolicyAdmin
InsurancePolicyAdmin.description: Enables policy administration features. Provides one seat of the InsurancePolicyAdministrationAddOn license.

IntelligentDocumentReader.name: IntelligentDocumentReader
IntelligentDocumentReader.description: Provides the license required to enable and use Intelligent Document Reader in a scratch org. Intelligent Document Reader uses optical character recognition to automatically extract data with Amazon Textract by using your AWS account.

Interaction.name: Interaction
Interaction.description: Enables flows. A flow is the part of Salesforce Flow that collects data and performs actions in your Salesforce org or an external system. Salesforce Flow provides two types of flows: screen flows and autolaunched flows.

InvestigativeCaseManagement.name: InvestigativeCaseManagement
InvestigativeCaseManagement.description: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing investigative cases, including evidence management and case proceedings, in Public Sector Solutions.

InvocableActionExt.name: InvocableActionExt
InvocableActionExt.description: Enables the use of InvocableActionExtension metadata to customize how Apex invocable action inputs appear in Flow Builder.

InvoiceManagement.name: InvoiceManagement
InvoiceManagement.description: Enables access to all the Billing features and objects that are available with the Revenue Cloud Advanced license in the scratch org.
InvoiceManagement.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

IoT.name: IoT
IoT.description: Enables IoT so the scratch org can consume platform events to perform business and service workflows using orchestrations and contexts.

JigsawUser.name: JigsawUser
JigsawUser.description: Provides one license to Jigsaw features.

Knowledge.name: Knowledge
Knowledge.description: Enables Salesforce Knowledge and gives your website visitors, clients, partners, and service agents the ultimate support tool. Create and manage a knowledge base with your company information, and securely share it when and where it’s needed. Build a knowledge base of articles that can include information on process, like how to reset your product to its defaults, or frequently asked questions.

LegacyLiveAgentRouting.name: LegacyLiveAgentRouting
LegacyLiveAgentRouting.description: Enables legacy Live Agent routing for Chat. Use Live Agent routing to chat in Salesforce Classic. Chats in Lightning Experience must be routed using Omni-Channel.

LifeSciencesCloudForCustomerEngagement.name: LifeSciencesCloudForCustomerEngagement
LifeSciencesCloudForCustomerEngagement.description: Enables use of Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement.

LightningSalesConsole.name: LightningSalesConsole
LightningSalesConsole.description: Adds one Lighting Sales Console user license.

LightningScheduler.name: LightningScheduler
LightningScheduler.description: Enables Lightning Scheduler. Lightning Scheduler gives you tools to simplify appointment scheduling in Salesforce. Create a personalized experience by scheduling customer appointments—in person, by phone, or by video—with the right person at the right place and time.

LightningServiceConsole.name: LightningServiceConsole
LightningServiceConsole.description: Assigns the Lightning Service Console License to your scratch org so you can use the Lightning Service Console and access features that help manage cases faster.

LiveAgent.name: LiveAgent
LiveAgent.description: Enables Chat for Service Cloud. Use web-based chat to quickly connect customers to agents for real-time support.

LiveMessage.name: LiveMessage
LiveMessage.description: Enables Messaging for Service Cloud. Use Messaging to quickly support customers using apps such as SMS text messaging and Facebook Messenger.

LongLayoutSectionTitles.name: LongLayoutSectionTitles
LongLayoutSectionTitles.description: Allows page layout section titles to be up to 80 characters.

LoyaltyAnalytics.name: LoyaltyAnalytics
LoyaltyAnalytics.description: Enables Analytics for Loyalty license. The Analytics for Loyalty app gives you actionable insights into your loyalty programs.

LoyaltyEngine.name: LoyaltyEngine
LoyaltyEngine.description: Enables Loyalty Management Promotion Setup license. Promotion setup allows loyalty program managers to create loyalty program processes. Loyalty program processes help you decide how incoming and new Accrual and Redemption-type transactions are processed.

LoyaltyManagementStarter.name: LoyaltyManagementStarter
LoyaltyManagementStarter.description: Enables the Loyalty Management - Starter license. Create loyalty programs and set up loyalty program-specific processes that allow you to recognize, rewards, and retain customers.

LoyaltyMaximumPartners.name: LoyaltyMaximumPartners
LoyaltyMaximumPartners.description: Increases the number of loyalty program partners that can be associated with a loyalty program in an org where the Loyalty Management - Starter license is enabled. The default and maximum value is 1.

LoyaltyMaximumPrograms.name: LoyaltyMaximumPrograms
LoyaltyMaximumPrograms.description: Increases the number of loyalty programs that can be created in an org where the Loyalty Management - Starter license is enabled. The default and maximum value is 1.

LoyaltyMaxOrderLinePerHour.name: LoyaltyMaxOrderLinePerHour
LoyaltyMaxOrderLinePerHour.description: Increases the number of order lines that can be cumulatively processed per hour by loyalty program processes. Indicate a value between 1–3,500,000.

LoyaltyMaxProcExecPerHour.name: LoyaltyMaxProcExecPerHour
LoyaltyMaxProcExecPerHour.description: Increases the number of transaction journals that can be processed by loyalty program processes per hour. Indicate a value between 1–500,000.

LoyaltyMaxTransactions.name: LoyaltyMaxTransactions
LoyaltyMaxTransactions.description: Increases the number of Transaction Journal records that can be processed. Indicate a value between 1–50,000,000.

LoyaltyMaxTrxnJournals.name: LoyaltyMaxTrxnJournals
LoyaltyMaxTrxnJournals.description: Increases the number of Transaction Journal records that can be stored in an org that has the Loyalty Management - Start license enabled.

Macros.name: Macros
Macros.description: Enables macros in your scratch org. After enabling macros, add the macro browser to the Lightning Console so you can configure predefined instructions for commonly used actions and apply them to multiple posts at the same time.

MarketingCloud.name: MarketingCloud
MarketingCloud.description: Provides licenses for Marketing Cloud Advanced edition. These licenses provide access to campaigns, flows, emails, forms, landing pages, and consent management features. You can send up to 20 emails per day from a scratch org.

MarketingUser.name: MarketingUser
MarketingUser.description: Provides access to the Campaigns object. Without this setting, Campaigns are read-only.

MaterialityAssessment.name: MaterialityAssessment
MaterialityAssessment.description: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to configure materiality assessment in Net Zero Cloud.

MaxActiveDPEDefs.name: MaxActiveDPEDefs
MaxActiveDPEDefs.description: Increases the number of Data Processing Engine definitions that can be activated in the org. Indicate a value between 1–50.

MaxApexCodeSize.name: MaxApexCodeSize
MaxApexCodeSize.description: Limits the non-test, unmanaged Apex code size (in MB). To use a value greater than the default value of 10, contact Salesforce Customer Support.

MaxAudTypeCriterionPerAud.name: MaxAudTypeCriterionPerAud
MaxAudTypeCriterionPerAud.description: Limits the number of audience type criteria available per audience. The default value is 10.

MaxCustomLabels.name: MaxCustomLabels
MaxCustomLabels.description: Limits the number of custom labels (measured in thousands). Setting the limit to 10 enables the scratch org to have 10,000 custom labels. Indicate a value between 1–15.

MaxDatasetLinksPerDT.name: MaxDatasetLinksPerDT
MaxDatasetLinksPerDT.description: Increases the number of dataset links that can be associated with a decision table. Indicate a value between 1–3.

MaxDataSourcesPerDPE.name: MaxDataSourcesPerDPE
MaxDataSourcesPerDPE.description: Increases the number of Source Object nodes a Data Processing Engine definition can contain. Indicate a value between 1–50.

MaxDecisionTableAllowed.name: MaxDecisionTableAllowed
MaxDecisionTableAllowed.description: Increases the number of decision tables rules that can be created in the org. Indicate a value between 1–30.

MaxFavoritesAllowed.name: MaxFavoritesAllowed
MaxFavoritesAllowed.description: Increases the number of Favorites allowed. Favorites allow users to create a shortcut to a Salesforce Page. Users can view their Favorites by clicking the Favorites list dropdown in the header. Indicate a value between 0–200.

MaxFieldsPerNode.name: MaxFieldsPerNode
MaxFieldsPerNode.description: Increases the number of fields a node in a Data Processing Engine definition can contain. Indicate a value between 1–500.

MaxInputColumnsPerDT.name: MaxInputColumnsPerDT
MaxInputColumnsPerDT.description: Increases the number of input fields a decision table can contain. Indicate a value between 1–10.

MaxLoyaltyProcessRules.name: MaxLoyaltyProcessRules
MaxLoyaltyProcessRules.description: Increases the number of loyalty program process rules that can be created in the org. Indicate a value between 1–20.

MaxNodesPerDPE.name: MaxNodesPerDPE
MaxNodesPerDPE.description: Increases the number of nodes that a Data Processing Engine definition can contain. Indicate a value between 1–500.

MaxNoOfLexThemesAllowed.name: MaxNoOfLexThemesAllowed
MaxNoOfLexThemesAllowed.description: Increases the number of Themes allowed. Themes allow users to configure colors, fonts, images, sizes, and more. Access the list of Themes in Setup, under Themes and Branding. Indicate a value between 0–300.

MaxOutputColumnsPerDT.name: MaxOutputColumnsPerDT
MaxOutputColumnsPerDT.description: Increases the number of output fields a decision table can contain. Indicate a value between 1–5.

MaxSourceObjectPerDSL.name: MaxSourceObjectPerDSL
MaxSourceObjectPerDSL.description: Increases the number of source objects that can be selected in a dataset link of a decision table. Indicate a value between 1–5.

MaxStreamingTopics.name: MaxStreamingTopics
MaxStreamingTopics.description: Increases the maximum number of delivered PushTopic event notifications within a 24-hour period, shared by all CometD clients. Indicate a value between 40–100.

MaxUserNavItemsAllowed.name: MaxUserNavItemsAllowed
MaxUserNavItemsAllowed.description: Increases the number of navigation items a user can add to the navigation bar. Indicate a value between 0–500.

MaxUserStreamingChannels.name: MaxUserStreamingChannels
MaxUserStreamingChannels.description: Increases the maximum number of user-defined channels for generic streaming. Indicate a value between 20–1,000.

MaxWishlistsItemsPerWishlist.name: MaxWishlistsItemsPerWishlist
MaxWishlistsItemsPerWishlist.description: Limits the number of wishlist items per wishlist. The default value is 500.

MaxWishlistsPerStoreAccUsr.name: MaxWishlistsPerStoreAccUsr
MaxWishlistsPerStoreAccUsr.description: Limits the number of wishlists allowed per store, account, and user. The default value is 100.

MaxWritebacksPerDPE.name: MaxWritebacksPerDPE
MaxWritebacksPerDPE.description: Increases the number of Writeback Object nodes a Data Processing Engine definition can contain. Indicate a value between 1–50.

MedVisDescriptorLimit.name: MedVisDescriptorLimit
MedVisDescriptorLimit.description: Increases the number of sharing definitions allowed per record for sharing inheritance to be applied to an object. Indicate a value between 150–1,600.

MinKeyRotationInterval.name: MinKeyRotationInterval
MinKeyRotationInterval.description: Sets the encryption key material rotation interval at once per 60 seconds. If this feature isn’t specified, the rotation interval defaults to once per 604,800 seconds (7 days) for Search Index key material, and once per 86,400 seconds (24 hours) for all other key material.

MobileExtMaxFileSizeMB.name: MobileExtMaxFileSizeMB
MobileExtMaxFileSizeMB.description: Increases the file size (in megabytes) for Field Service Mobile extensions. Indicate a value between 1–2,000.

MobileSecurity.name: MobileSecurity
MobileSecurity.description: Enables Enhanced Mobile Security. With Enhanced Mobile Security, you can control a range of policies to create a security solution tailored to your org’s needs. You can limit user access based on operating system versions, app versions, and device and network security. You can also specify the severity of a violation.

MobileVoiceAndLLM.name: MobileVoiceAndLLM
MobileVoiceAndLLM.description: Allows mobile apps to download large language models (LLMs) and voice models for offline use from the model store service. Normally, mobile apps have access to the model store service when Einstein is enabled, but the MobileVoiceAndLLM scratch org feature enables offline voice without requiring orgs to fully enable Einstein.

MultiLevelMasterDetail.name: MultiLevelMasterDetail
MultiLevelMasterDetail.description: Allows the creation a special type of parent-child relationship between one object, the child, or detail, and another object, the parent, or master.

MutualAuthentication.name: MutualAuthentication
MutualAuthentication.description: Requires client certificates to verify inbound requests for mutual authentication.

MyTrailhead.name: MyTrailhead
MyTrailhead.description: Enables access to a myTrailhead enablement site in a scratch org.

NonprofitCloudCaseManagementUser.name: NonprofitCloudCaseManagementUser
NonprofitCloudCaseManagementUser.description: Provides the permission set license required to use and configure the Salesforce.org Nonprofit Cloud Case Management managed package. You can then install the package in the scratch org.

NumPlatformEvents.name: NumPlatformEvents
NumPlatformEvents.description: Increases the maximum number of platform event definitions that can be created. Indicate a value between 5–20.

ObjectLinking.name: ObjectLinking
ObjectLinking.description: Create rules to quickly link channel interactions to objects such as contacts, leads, or person accounts for customers (Beta).

OmnistudioDesigner.name: OmnistudioDesigner
OmnistudioDesigner.description: Enables administrator or developer to create new OmniScripts/ DataMappers / Integration Procedures instances.

OmnistudioMetadata.name: OmnistudioMetadata
OmnistudioMetadata.description: Enables Omnistudio metadata API. Using this API, customers can deploy and retrieve Omnistudio components programmatically.

OmnistudioRuntime.name: OmnistudioRuntime
OmnistudioRuntime.description: Enables business users to execute OmniScripts, DataMappers, FlexCards, and so on in the employee facing applications.

OrderManagement.name: OrderManagement
OrderManagement.description: Provides the Salesforce Order Management license. Order Management is your central hub for handling all aspects of the order lifecycle, including order capture, fulfillment, shipping, payment processing, and servicing.
OrderManagement.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

OrderSaveBehaviorBoth.name: OrderSaveBehaviorBoth
OrderSaveBehaviorBoth.description: Enables scratch org support for both New Order Save Behavior and Old Order Save Behavior.

OrderSaveLogicEnabled.name: OrderSaveLogicEnabled
OrderSaveLogicEnabled.description: Enables scratch org support for New Order Save Behavior. OrderSaveLogicEnabled supports only New Order Save Behavior. If your scratch org needs both Old and New Order Save Behavior, use OrderSaveBehaviorBoth.

OutboundMessageHTTPSession.name: OutboundMessageHTTPSession
OutboundMessageHTTPSession.description: Enables using HTTP endpoint URLs in outbound message definitions that have the Send Session ID option selected.

OutcomeManagement.name: OutcomeManagement
OutcomeManagement.description: Gives users access to Outcome Management features and objects in Salesforce and Experience Cloud.

PardotScFeaturesCampaignInfluence.name: PardotScFeaturesCampaignInfluence
PardotScFeaturesCampaignInfluence.description: Enables additional campaign influence models, first touch, last touch, and even distribution for Pardot users.

PersonAccounts.name: PersonAccounts
PersonAccounts.description: Enables person accounts in your scratch org.
PersonAccounts.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

PipelineInspection.name: PipelineInspection
PipelineInspection.description: Enables Pipeline Inspection. Pipeline Inspection is a consolidated pipeline view with metrics, opportunities, and highlights of recent changes.
PipelineInspection.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.

PlatformCache.name: PlatformCache
PlatformCache.description: Enables Platform Cache and allocates a 3 MB cache. The Lightning Platform Cache layer provides faster performance and better reliability when caching Salesforce session and org data.

PlatformConnect.name: PlatformConnect
PlatformConnect.description: Enables Salesforce Connect and allows your users to view, search, and modify data that’s stored outside your Salesforce org. Indicate a value from 1–5.

PlatformEncryption.name: PlatformEncryption
PlatformEncryption.description: Shield Platform Encryption encrypts data at rest. You can manage key material and encrypt fields, files, and other data.

PlatformEventsPerDay.name: PlatformEventsPerDay
PlatformEventsPerDay.description: Increases the maximum number of delivered standard-volume platform event notifications within a 24-hour period, shared by all CometD clients. Indicate a value between 10,000–50,000.

ProcessBuilder.name: ProcessBuilder
ProcessBuilder.description: Enables Process Builder, a Salesforce Flow tool that helps you automate your business processes.

ProductCatalogManagementAddOn.name: ProductCatalogManagementAddOn
ProductCatalogManagementAddOn.description: Enables read-write access to Product Catalog Management features and objects.
ProductCatalogManagementAddOn.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

ProductCatalogManagementPCAddOn.name: ProductCatalogManagementPCAddOn
ProductCatalogManagementPCAddOn.description: Enables read access to Product Catalog Management features and objects for Partner Community Users in scratch orgs.
ProductCatalogManagementPCAddOn.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

ProductCatalogManagementViewerAddOn.name: ProductCatalogManagementViewerAddOn
ProductCatalogManagementViewerAddOn.description: Enables read access to Product Catalog Management features and objects.
ProductCatalogManagementViewerAddOn.editionNotes: Available in Developer and Enterprise scratch org editions.

ProductsAndSchedules.name: ProductsAndSchedules
ProductsAndSchedules.description: Enables product schedules in your scratch org. Enabling this feature lets you create default product schedules on products. Users can also create schedules for individual products on opportunities.

ProgramManagement.name: ProgramManagement
ProgramManagement.description: Enables access to all Program Management and Case Management features and objects.

ProviderFreePlatformCache.name: ProviderFreePlatformCache
ProviderFreePlatformCache.description: Provides 3 MB of free Platform Cache capacity for security-reviewed managed packages. This feature is made available through a capacity type called Provider Free capacity and is automatically enabled in Developer Edition orgs. Allocate the Provider Free capacity to a Platform Cache partition and add it to your managed package.

ProviderManagement.name: ProviderManagement
ProviderManagement.description: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing provider networks, care plans, and service delivery in Public Sector Solutions.

PSSAssetManagement.name: PSSAssetManagement
PSSAssetManagement.description: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing assets in Public Sector Solutions.

PublicSectorAccess.name: PublicSectorAccess
PublicSectorAccess.description: Enables access to all Public Sector features and objects.

PublicSectorApplicationUsageCreditsAddOn.name: PublicSectorApplicationUsageCreditsAddOn
PublicSectorApplicationUsageCreditsAddOn.description: Enables additional usage of Public Sector applications based on their pricing.

PublicSectorSiteTemplate.name: PublicSectorSiteTemplate
PublicSectorSiteTemplate.description: Allows Public Sector users access to build an Experience Cloud site from the templates available.

RateManagement.name: RateManagement
RateManagement.description: Enables Rate Management that allows you to set, manage, and optimize rates for usage-based products.

RecordTypes.name: RecordTypes
RecordTypes.description: Enables Record Type functionality. Record Types let you offer different business processes, picklist values, and page layouts to different users.

RefreshOnInvalidSession.name: RefreshOnInvalidSession
RefreshOnInvalidSession.description: Enables automatic refreshes of Lightning pages when the user’s session is invalid. If, however, the page detects a new token, it tries to set that token and continue without a refresh.

RevSubscriptionManagement.name: RevSubscriptionManagement
RevSubscriptionManagement.description: Enables Subscription Management. Subscription Management is an API-first, product-to-cash solution for B2B subscriptions and one-time sales.

S1ClientComponentCacheSize.name: S1ClientComponentCacheSize
S1ClientComponentCacheSize.description: Allows the org to have up to 5 pages of caching for Lightning Components.

SalesCloudEinstein.name: SalesCloudEinstein
SalesCloudEinstein.description: Enables Sales Cloud Einstein features and Salesforce Inbox. Sales Cloud Einstein brings AI to every step of the sales process.
SalesCloudEinstein.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise Edition scratch orgs.

SalesforceContentUser.name: SalesforceContentUser
SalesforceContentUser.description: Enables access to Salesforce content features.

SalesforceFeedbackManagementStarter.name: SalesforceFeedbackManagementStarter
SalesforceFeedbackManagementStarter.description: Provides a license to use the Salesforce Feedback Management - Starter features.
SalesforceFeedbackManagementStarter.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer edition scratch orgs.

SalesforceHostedMCP.name: SalesforceHostedMCP
SalesforceHostedMCP.description: Enables hosted MCP servers on the scratch org. With this scratch org feature parameter, MCP clients can connect to available hosted MCP servers.

SalesforceIdentityForCommunities.name: SalesforceIdentityForCommunities
SalesforceIdentityForCommunities.description: Adds Salesforce Identity components, including login and self-registration, to Experience Builder. This feature is required for Aura components.

SalesforcePricing.name: SalesforcePricing
SalesforcePricing.description: Enables Salesforce Pricing, which allows you to set, manage, and optimize prices across your entire product portfolio

SalesUser.name: SalesUser
SalesUser.description: Provides a license for Sales Cloud features.

SAML20SingleLogout.name: SAML20SingleLogout
SAML20SingleLogout.description: Enables usage of SAML 2.0 single logout.

SCIMProtocol.name: SCIMProtocol
SCIMProtocol.description: Enables access support for the SCIM protocol base API.

ScvMultipartyAndConsult.name: ScvMultipartyAndConsult
ScvMultipartyAndConsult.description: Enables you to set up and test multiparty calls and consult calls for Service Cloud Voice with Partner Telephony.
ScvMultipartyAndConsult.editionNotes: Available in Salesforce Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions.

SecurityEventEnabled.name: SecurityEventEnabled
SecurityEventEnabled.description: Enables access to security events in Event Monitoring.

SentimentInsightsFeature.name: SentimentInsightsFeature
SentimentInsightsFeature.description: Provides the license required to enable and use Sentiment Insights in a scratch org. Use Sentiment Insights to analyze the sentiment of your customers and get actionable insights to improve it.

ServiceCatalog.name: ServiceCatalog
ServiceCatalog.description: Enables Employee Service Catalog so you can create a catalog of products and services for your employees. It can also turn your employees’ requests for these products and services into approved and documented orders.

ServiceCloud.name: ServiceCloud
ServiceCloud.description: Assigns the Service Cloud license to your scratch org, so you can choose how your customers can reach you, such as by email, phone, social media, online communities, chat, and text.

ServiceCloudVoicePartnerTelephony.name: ServiceCloudVoicePartnerTelephony
ServiceCloudVoicePartnerTelephony.description: Assigns the Service Cloud Voice with Partner Telephony add-on license to your scratch org, so you can set up a Service Cloud Voice contact center that integrates with supported telephony providers. Indicate a value from 1–50.

ServiceUser.name: ServiceUser
ServiceUser.description: Adds one Service Cloud User license, and allows access to Service Cloud features.

SessionIdInLogEnabled.name: SessionIdInLogEnabled
SessionIdInLogEnabled.description: Enables Apex debug logs to include session IDs. If disabled, session IDs are replaced with “SESSION_ID_REMOVED” in debug logs.

SFDOInsightsDataIntegrityUser.name: SFDOInsightsDataIntegrityUser
SFDOInsightsDataIntegrityUser.description: Provides a license to Salesforce.org Insights Platform Data Integrity managed package. You can then install the package in the scratch org.

SharedActivities.name: SharedActivities
SharedActivities.description: Allow users to relate multiple contacts to tasks and events.

Sites.name: Sites
Sites.description: Enables Salesforce Sites, which allows you to create public websites and applications that are directly integrated with your Salesforce org. Users aren’t required to log in with a username and password.

SocialCustomerService.name: SocialCustomerService
SocialCustomerService.description: Enables Social Customer Service, sets post defaults, and either activates the Starter Pack or signs into your Social Studio account.

StateAndCountryPicklist.name: StateAndCountryPicklist
StateAndCountryPicklist.description: Enables state and country/territory picklists. State and country/territory picklists let users select states and countries from predefined, standardized lists, instead of entering state, country, and territory data into text fields.

StreamingAPI.name: StreamingAPI
StreamingAPI.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer Edition scratch orgs.

StreamingEventsPerDay.name: StreamingEventsPerDay
StreamingEventsPerDay.description: Increases the maximum number of delivered PushTopic event notifications within a 24-hour period, shared by all CometD clients (API version 36.0 and earlier). Indicate a value between 10,000–50,000.

SubPerStreamingChannel.name: SubPerStreamingChannel
SubPerStreamingChannel.description: Increases the maximum number of concurrent clients (subscribers) per generic streaming channel (API version 36.0 and earlier). Indicate a value between 20–4,000.

SubPerStreamingTopic.name: SubPerStreamingTopic
SubPerStreamingTopic.description: Increases the maximum number of concurrent clients (subscribers) per PushTopic streaming channel (API version 36.0 and earlier). Indicate a value between 20–4,000.

SurveyAdvancedFeatures.name: SurveyAdvancedFeatures
SurveyAdvancedFeatures.description: Enables a license for the features available with the Salesforce Feedback Management - Growth license.
SurveyAdvancedFeatures.editionNotes: Available in Enterprise and Developer edition scratch orgs.

SustainabilityApp.name: SustainabilityApp
SustainabilityApp.description: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to configure Net Zero Cloud. To enable or use Tableau CRM and Tableau CRM templates, include the DevelopmentWave scratch org feature.

SustainabilityCloud.name: SustainabilityCloud
SustainabilityCloud.description: Provides the permission set licenses and permission sets required to install and configure Sustainability Cloud. To enable or use CRM Analytics and CRM Analytics templates, include the DevelopmentWave scratch org feature.

TalentRecruitmentManagement.name: TalentRecruitmentManagement
TalentRecruitmentManagement.description: Enables the objects, features, and permissions for managing the talent recruitment and hiring process in Public Sector Solutions.

TCRMforSustainability.name: TCRMforSustainability
TCRMforSustainability.description: Enables all permissions required to manage the Net Zero Analytics app by enabling Tableau CRM. You can create and share the analytics app for your users to bring your environmental accounting in line with your financial accounting.

TimelineConditionsLimit.name: TimelineConditionsLimit
TimelineConditionsLimit.description: Limits the number of timeline record display conditions per event type to 3.

TimelineEventLimit.name: TimelineEventLimit
TimelineEventLimit.description: Limits the number of event types displayed on a timeline to 5.

TimelineRecordTypeLimit.name: TimelineRecordTypeLimit
TimelineRecordTypeLimit.description: Limits the number of related object record types per event type to 3.

TimeSheetTemplateSettings.name: TimeSheetTemplateSettings
TimeSheetTemplateSettings.description: Time Sheet Templates let you configure settings to create time sheets automatically. For example, you can create a template that sets start and end dates. Assign templates to user profiles so that time sheets are created for the right users.

TransactionFinalizers.name: TransactionFinalizers
TransactionFinalizers.description: Enables you to implement and attach Apex Finalizers to Queueable Apex jobs.

UsageManagement.name: UsageManagement
UsageManagement.description: Enables Usage Management. Using Usage Management, you can setup, track, and manage the consumption of usage-based products.

VolunteerManagement.name: VolunteerManagement
VolunteerManagement.description: Gives users access to Volunteer Management features and objects in Salesforce.

WaveMaxCurrency.name: WaveMaxCurrency
WaveMaxCurrency.description: Increases the maximum number of supported currencies for CRM Analytics. Indicate a value between 1–5.

Workflow.name: Workflow
Workflow.description: Enables Workflow so you can automate standard internal procedures and processes.

WorkflowFlowActionFeature.name: WorkflowFlowActionFeature
WorkflowFlowActionFeature.description: Allows you to launch a flow from a workflow action.

WorkplaceCommandCenterUser.name: WorkplaceCommandCenterUser
WorkplaceCommandCenterUser.description: Enables access to Workplace Command Center features including access to objects such as Employee, Crisis, and EmployeeCrisisAssessment.

WorkThanksPref.name: WorkThanksPref
WorkThanksPref.description: Enables the give thanks feature in Chatter.
